Name: Gwen's Semi-Realistic Haley HD Portrait
Author: gweneverest
Description:
[center]This mod currently only features Haley. I've also released Sebastian [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55519]here[/url], Abigail [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55538]here[/url], and Sam [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55631]here[/url]. I have plans to release more bachelors and bachelorettes, most likely individually.

[u]How to install?
[/u][/center]
[center]1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] and extract it to your mods folder
2. Download Gwen's HD Portraits - Haley, and extract it to mods\Portraiture\portraits
3. You should have 'mods\Portraiture\Portraits\Gwen's HD Portraits\Haley.png'
4. While talking to Haley ingame, press P till Gwen's HD Portraits appears

In the screenshots, I'm using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11338]Citrus Interface [/url]by ninthalley.[/center]
